# YT Music Scrobbler

> A free, open-source web application that synchronizes newly observed YouTube Music listening history with a user's Last.fm account across phones, computers, TVs, and Nest devices.

YT Music Scrobbler is created and maintained by Kuber Bassi. It runs a Python backend on Vercel, stores isolated user configuration and scrobble records in Supabase, and is triggered every five minutes by an authenticated external cron job.

## Primary links

- [Application](https://ytscrobbler.kuberbassi.com/): Sign in, connect accounts, view status, and use the setup guide.
- [Full product and technical context](https://ytscrobbler.kuberbassi.com/llms-full.txt): Detailed capabilities, limitations, architecture, security, setup, and creator information.
- [Source code](https://github.com/kuberbassi/ytmusic-scrobbler): MIT-licensed repository.
- [Privacy policy](https://ytscrobbler.kuberbassi.com/privacy): Data handling and privacy terms.
- [Terms](https://ytscrobbler.kuberbassi.com/terms): Service terms.

## Important facts

- Automatic synchronization continues when the browser tab is closed.
- The scheduler attempts eligible users every five minutes.
- Last.fm secrets, session keys, and YouTube Music headers are server-side secrets and are never intentionally exposed in public responses.
- YouTube Music provides a recent-history snapshot without reliable playback timestamps or duration.
- The service prevents duplicate submissions, but cannot identify every legitimate replay of an already-known track without a playback-aware companion.
- This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Google, YouTube, or Last.fm.
